title: Ghana: Gaming Giant Tada Expands Into South Africa, Ghana Potentially Next
desc: Africa's online gaming sector continues to grow by leaps and bounds throughout the continent, and TaDa Gaming is making sure it's a big part of that. Earlier this month, TaDA finalized an agreement with South Africa-based online casino Sunbet to make its games available to South African players. This deal is just the latest example of TaDa expanding its presence in the African gaming market, as well as a signal that Ghana's gaming market may not be far away.
